title.en: Enable Azure backup for FSLogix storage account file shares

summary.en: It is recommended to enable backup on the FSLogix Storage Account. Ensuring the user profiles are resilient will allow user data and experience to be consistent through outages.

rationale.en: A backup retains recoverable state independently of the current live copy. Protection is demonstrated by successful recovery points and a usable restoration procedure, not by a policy assignment or a recent backup-job start.
rationale.ko: 백업은 현재 운영 사본과 별도로 복구 가능한 상태를 보존합니다. 정책 할당이나 작업 시작 기록만으로 보호 상태를 판단하지 않고, 성공한 복구 지점과 실제로 사용할 수 있는 복원 절차를 확인합니다.

applicability.en: Source resource or workload: Microsoft.Subscription/subscriptions. Specific focus: FSLogix share backups.
Identify the exact supported data or configuration objects, consistency requirements, retention, recovery location and encryption-key dependencies.
applicability.ko: 지원되는 데이터와 구성 개체, 일관성 조건, 보존 기간, 복구 위치와 암호화 키 의존성을 확인합니다.

applicability.en: AVD control-plane availability does not recover session hosts, FSLogix profiles, directory services or networking. Include those dependencies and user reconnection in recovery.
applicability.ko: AVD 관리 계층의 가용성이 세션 호스트, FSLogix 프로필, 디렉터리 서비스나 네트워크를 복구하지는 않습니다. 해당 의존성과 사용자 재연결을 복구에 포함합니다.

applicability.en: The source classifies this specialized workload under a subscription. The actual objects to inspect are the FSLogix share backups targets and their dependencies, not a subscription setting assumed to implement the recommendation.
applicability.ko: 원본은 이 전문 워크로드를 구독 아래 분류합니다. 실제 점검 대상은 권고에 명시된 리소스와 그 의존성입니다. 구독 설정 하나가 권고를 구현한다고 가정하지 않습니다.

before.en: Live data or configuration may have no recent recoverable copy, or recovery has not been demonstrated.
before.ko: 운영 데이터나 구성에 최근 복구 사본이 없거나 복구 가능성을 확인하지 않았을 수 있습니다.

before.en: Recommendation-specific baseline to inspect: Azure Files backup policy covers profile shares with recoverable and tested profile data. This is an inspection question, not a finding about the current environment.

after.en: The intended objects have successful retained recovery points and a documented, tested restoration path.

implementation_steps.en: Identify actual FSLogix share backups target objects inside the workload's subscription scope and read their specific current configuration. Subscription classification is not a substitute for identifying host pools, shares, clusters or other real targets.
Select the service-supported protection mechanism and schedule, protect required keys and metadata, and arrange a nonproduction restore target with suitable permissions.

Check job completion and recovery-point freshness, restore a representative object into an isolated target, and verify application-level consistency and measured recovery time.

title.en: Private endpoint should be configured for Key Vault

summary.en: Azure Private Link Service lets you securely and privately connect to Azure Key Vault via a Private Endpoint in your VNet, using a private IP and eliminating public Internet exposure.

benefits.en: Secure Key Vault with Private Link

rationale.en: Private access joins a client network, a name-resolution path and a service-specific private connection. An approved endpoint without correct DNS or an allowed data path does not provide usable private connectivity.
rationale.ko: 프라이빗 접근은 클라이언트 네트워크, 이름 해석 경로와 서비스별 프라이빗 연결을 함께 구성해야 합니다. 엔드포인트를 승인해도 DNS나 허용된 데이터 경로가 올바르지 않으면 연결할 수 없습니다.

applicability.en: Source resource or workload: Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults. Specific focus: Key Vault private access.
Check service and tier support, required subresources, endpoint approval, private DNS zones and client network topology.
applicability.ko: 서비스와 계층의 지원, 필요한 하위 리소스, 엔드포인트 승인, Private DNS 영역과 클라이언트 네트워크 구조를 확인합니다.

before.en: Clients may use a public path or resolve a private name to an address they cannot reach.
before.ko: 클라이언트가 공용 경로를 사용하거나 접근할 수 없는 주소로 이름을 해석할 수 있습니다.

before.en: Recommendation-specific baseline to inspect: Approved private endpoint, DNS and authorized application secret access. This is an inspection question, not a finding about the current environment.

after.en: The intended client resolves the service through the correct private path and can make an authorized data-plane request.
after.ko: 의도한 클라이언트가 올바른 프라이빗 경로로 서비스를 해석하고 승인된 데이터 요청을 보낼 수 있습니다.

Plan private endpoint subresources, approve the connection through the normal owner process, configure DNS links or forwarding and validate access before changing public-network settings.

title.en: Enable Soft Delete to protect your data

summary.en: The soft delete option enables data recovery if mistakenly deleted, while the Lock feature prevents the accidental deletion of the storage account itself, ensuring additional security and data integrity measures.

rationale.en: Soft delete, purge protection and version retention extend the opportunity to recover from accidental removal or overwrite. Their scopes and expiry rules differ, so the exact object type and recovery window must be explicit.
rationale.ko: 일시 삭제, 제거 보호, 버전 보존은 실수로 삭제하거나 덮어쓴 상태를 복구할 시간을 확보합니다. 적용 개체와 만료 규칙이 다르므로 정확한 대상과 복구 가능 기간을 명시해야 합니다.

applicability.en: Source resource or workload: Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts. Specific focus: Storage soft delete.
Check support for the exact object type, retention range, irreversible settings and interaction with lifecycle cleanup or legal retention.
applicability.ko: 대상 개체의 지원 여부, 보존 기간 범위, 되돌릴 수 없는 설정과 수명 주기 정리 또는 법적 보존 조건을 확인합니다.

applicability.en: LRS, ZRS, GRS and GZRS cover different failure domains. Blob, file and account recovery features differ; replication does not undo a deletion or corruption.

before.en: Deleted or overwritten objects can become irrecoverable immediately or before operators notice the incident.

title.en: Use failover group customer managed policy

summary.en: When using failover groups, setting your failover policy to customer managed is highly recommended as it keeps you in control of when to initiate a failover.

rationale.en: Business continuity requires a sequence that restores a usable business flow, including state, identity, networking, capacity and operator access. A plan must make dependencies, decision points, data-loss tradeoffs and failback explicit.
rationale.ko: 업무 연속성을 확보하려면 데이터, 신원, 네트워크, 용량과 운영자 접근을 포함해 업무 흐름을 복구하는 순서가 필요합니다. 의존성, 판단 시점, 데이터 손실의 절충과 원복 방법을 계획에 명시해야 합니다.

applicability.en: Source resource or workload: Microsoft.Sql/servers. Specific focus: SQL failover policy.
Use business-approved recovery time and recovery point targets and identify which regional and shared dependencies are actually in scope.
applicability.ko: 업무에서 승인한 복구 시간과 복구 시점 목표를 사용하고 실제 대상인 지역별 또는 공통 의존 리소스를 확인합니다.

applicability.en: Database replication, backup, TDE key recovery and listener routing have independent requirements. Readable secondaries and async failover can have lag and data-loss tradeoffs.
applicability.ko: 데이터베이스 복제, 백업, TDE 키 복구와 수신기 라우팅은 별도 조건을 가집니다. 읽기 보조와 비동기 장애 조치에는 지연 및 데이터 손실의 절충이 있을 수 있습니다.

before.en: Individual resources have protection features but the end-to-end recovery order, decision owner or failback is incomplete.
before.ko: 개별 리소스에 보호 기능이 있어도 전체 복구 순서, 판단 책임자 또는 원복 절차가 빠져 있을 수 있습니다.

before.en: Recommendation-specific baseline to inspect: Customer-managed failover policy, replication lag and operator decision criteria for data-loss tradeoffs. This is an inspection question, not a finding about the current environment.

after.en: A versioned dependency-aware runbook defines activation criteria, ordered recovery, validation and controlled failback.
after.ko: 버전으로 관리하는 실행 지침에 가동 기준, 의존성을 고려한 복구 순서, 검증과 통제된 원복을 정의합니다.

after.en: Intended source-specific outcome: Use failover group customer managed policy. Validate using: Customer-managed failover policy, replication lag and operator decision criteria for data-loss tradeoffs.

implementation_steps.en: Identify the actual in-scope Microsoft.Sql/servers objects and read their current SQL failover policy configuration. Record the scope and observation time; do not infer inventory from this conceptual guide.
Map the critical flow and dependencies, choose the supported recovery pattern, assign decision owners and specify rollback, stop conditions and reconciliation of divergent state.
implementation_steps.ko: 중요 업무 흐름과 의존성을 정리하고 지원되는 복구 방식을 선택합니다. 판단 책임자를 정하고 롤백, 중단 조건과 서로 달라진 데이터의 조정 방법을 명시합니다.

implementation_steps.en: Review the pinned APRL action 'Use failover group customer managed policy' against the original description and cited documentation. Prepare a supported, scoped change proposal and rollback; this guide itself does not execute or approve changes.

Prepare independent observations for: Customer-managed failover policy, replication lag and operator decision criteria for data-loss tradeoffs. Resolve unsupported or ambiguous conditions before proposing a change.

verification_steps.en: Inspect and retain source-attributed configuration or workload evidence for: Customer-managed failover policy, replication lag and operator decision criteria for data-loss tradeoffs.
Exercise the runbook in an approved scope and compare measured recovery time and data loss with targets; record blocked steps and unavailable dependencies instead of declaring success.
verification_steps.ko: 승인된 범위에서 실행 지침을 시험하고 실제 복구 시간과 데이터 손실을 목표와 비교합니다. 막힌 단계와 사용할 수 없는 의존 리소스를 성공으로 처리하지 않고 기록합니다.

verification_steps.en: Compare the observed SQL failover policy behavior with this recommendation's intended mechanism and the original source. Record timestamps, scope, missing coverage and conflicting observations.
Keep the existing automated, manual, blocked or unsupported assessment disposition separate. Missing evidence stays unknown; a diagram, a setting write or API acceptance is not operational success.
verification_steps.ko: 기존의 자동, 수동, blocked 또는 미지원 평가 상태를 별도로 유지합니다. 정보가 없으면 알 수 없음으로 남깁니다. 그림, 설정 쓰기나 API 수락은 운영 성공이 아닙니다.

cautions.en: A document or backup-job success is not a completed recovery. Regional capacity, identity and manual decision delays can dominate recovery time.
